papers.title: Typed State
papers.current_ceiling: The exact synthetic mechanism-isolation claim is supported; external decision value is intentionally unclaimed.
post_matrix_updates: Canonical PDF production has improved after #1731; the real scientific gap remains two-family transfer.
load_bearing_adverse: The E3/E2 successor has not run.
Synthetic exactness does not establish value in real decisions.
The legacy readiness heading says ORION-04 and requires an additive alias note rather than a frozen-byte rewrite.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The typed/scoped state composition must predict both value and no-value regimes under matched information in real decision families.
papers.decisive_question: Across Defects4J and OpenML-CC18, does typed scoped state improve downstream decisions only in prospectively predicted value strata while matching simpler states in predicted no-value strata?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Typed state is a causal mechanism for decision value, not merely a richer representation: its benefit follows responsibility and binding structure and vanishes in declared no-value regimes.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: The interaction between state type and predicted stratum should be positive under matched semantic information, with no unsafe-action increase and no forced advantage in no-value strata.
papers.population_or_universe: Prospectively selected E3 repair decisions and paper-disjoint E2 tabular decisions with frozen actions, utilities and state-construction access.
design: Define responsibilities, admissible actions and utility before constructing states.
Create matched-information typed, flattened and raw-state arms.
Predict value/no-value strata from design variables without held-out outcomes.
Hold out projects and OpenML task families.
Measure decision utility, safety and state/resource cost.
baselines: Untyped flattened state with identical facts.
primary_endpoints: State size, construction cost and inference cost.
negative_controls: Type labels permuted while values remain fixed.
Hidden information added to only one arm, which must fail matching checks.
analysis_plan: Primary estimand is the preregistered interaction, not an overall mean.
Cluster by project/task and report domain-specific effects.
No post hoc redefinition of value strata.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Power the interaction on project/task clusters using design-only variance estimates; include at least one frozen value and one no-value stratum in each domain.
papers.success_gate: Safe utility improvement in predicted value strata, equivalence/non-superiority in no-value strata and a positive frozen interaction in both domains.
papers.refutation_gate: No interaction, benefit caused by unmatched information or any safety degradation restricts the result to the synthetic mechanism paper.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if utilities, action sets, matching or strata are changed after held-out outcomes or if either domain lacks both strata.
papers.authority_required: Native tests/verifiers for E3, held-out labels for E2 and an independent matching auditor.

active_lane.collision_rule: Use paper-disjoint E2 tasks from ORION-02/22 and do not disturb the bounded synthetic receipts.

immediate_safe_actions: Write the responsibility/action/utility mapping for both domains.
Add the legacy ORION-04→ORION-08 alias note.
forbidden_actions: Do not equate richer state with more information.
Do not infer external validity from synthetic exactness.
Do not choose strata after seeing outcomes.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier causal representation paper needs matched information, predeclared value/no-value regimes, real decisions, safety endpoints and mechanism interactions.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns typed-state value; computation placement belongs to ORION-21 and reuse responsibility to ORION-23.
